properties.name: poli-page.api-key
properties.description: Your Poli Page API key, for example pp_sandbox_... or pp_live_.... Required and not blank. A key that does not match pp_{environment}_{32 lowercase hex characters} logs one warning at startup that shows no part of the key; the API decides whether it is valid. Find one at https://poli.page/dashboard/keys.

properties.name: poli-page.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Poli Page API. Override for staging or self-hosted deployments. Defaults to the SDK's own default (https://api.poli.page) when unset.

properties.name: poli-page.request-timeout
properties.description: Per-attempt request timeout. Falls back to the SDK's default (60 s) when unset.

properties.name: poli-page.retries.max-attempts
properties.description: Number of retries on top of the initial request. Set to 0 to disable retries. Falls back to the SDK's default (2) when unset.

properties.name: poli-page.retries.delay
properties.description: Base delay for the SDK's exponential backoff (jitter and Retry-After capping happen inside the SDK). Falls back to the SDK's default (500 ms) when unset.

properties.name: poli-page.health.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the Actuator HealthIndicator probing /v1/health. Defaults to true.

properties.name: poli-page.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the Micrometer MeterBinder publishing retry counters/timers and error counters. Defaults to true.

properties.name: poli-page.events.enabled
properties.description: Whether to bridge the SDK's onRetry/onError hooks to Spring ApplicationEvent. Defaults to true.

properties.name: poli-page.error-handler.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the PoliPageExceptionHandler, which answers an SDK error with its toPayload() body ({code, message, status, requestId}) and its status, or 500 when it has none. Defaults to true.
